lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor structure across the mid-to-posterior section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is observed across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to lower luminance in the lateral shadow region.
